tools.description: Writes contacts to a .vcf file, as Contacts' File > Export vCard does: chosen ones, a group's or smart list's, those matching a query, the My Card (Share My Card), or all. vCard 3.0 (or 2.1), with notes and photos unless turned off.

tools.description: Finds contacts as Contacts' search field does: every word of query must appear somewhere on the card (any name, company, job, phones, emails, addresses, URLs, social profiles, related names, the note), case and accents ignored. Narrow by phone or email (whole value), group (nested groups included), smart list, account and person or company; or pass criteria (smart-list rules) to find what a smart list would hold. Sorted as Contacts sorts them; each with its id and version.

account.description: Only cards in this account (name or id)

criteria.description: {match: all|any, rules: [{field, op, value}]}; a rule may itself be {match, rules}. Fields: any (any text on the card; ops contains, not_contains); name, first_name, last_name, middle_name, nickname, organization, department, job_title, note, phone, email, url, instant_message, street, city, state, zip, country (ops contains, not_contains, is, is_not, is_set, is_not_set; phone/email/url/instant_message also starts_with, ends_with); address (contains, not_contains, is_set, is_not_set); birthday, anniversary, date (next_days, within_days, not_within_days with a number of days; is_set, is_not_set); modified (changed_within_days, not_changed_within_days with days; after with 2026-10-21); group (member_of, not_member_of a group or smart list, by name or id)

group.description: Only members of this group (name or id), including its nested groups

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page

phone.description: A phone number, in any format

query.description: Words that must all appear on the card

smart_list.description: Only what this smart list holds (name or id)

tools.name: find_duplicates

tools.description: Imports a .vcf file (one or more vCards, with notes and photos) into an account and optionally a group. A card with the same name as an existing one in that account is a duplicate: skipped and listed (default), merged into it (update), added anyway (keep_both) or put in its place (replace: the old card is deleted, kept 30 days, and the new one joins its groups and links), as in Contacts' import review.

account.description: Account (name or id); default Contacts' default account

duplicates.description: What to do with a card whose name exists already; default skip

group.description: Also add the imported contacts to this group (name or id)

id.description: unlink: a card (only that one) or a contact (all its cards); prefer_name, prefer_photo: the card
